title: Reinstate consent
purpose: End a withdrawal because the participant consented again or because it was recorded in error, and release its holds.

sections.title: Withdrawal details
paragraphs: The form identifies the participant and study and shows the original withdrawal kind, effective date and recorder. If it was escalated, the form also shows the destruction instruction's effective date, receipt time and recorder.

items.label: New consent record
items.description: The current consent record made after the withdrawal and any escalation. The form preselects that record and its decision becomes the status. If consent was recorded between the withdrawal and escalation, record or correct it after escalation before reinstating. If no consent was recorded after the original withdrawal, the form offers None: the withdrawal was recorded in error. That choice restores the decision of the last record before the withdrawal.

items.label: Reinstated at
items.description: Required, in repository local time. Enter a time through now. If the withdrawal was escalated, enter a time from the destruction instruction's receipt onward.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required; kept in the history and on the released holds. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

sections.title: Independent review
paragraphs: A different manager or administrator must reinstate. The people who recorded the original withdrawal, its escalation or the current consent record made after the withdrawal are ineligible, including administrators and superusers. The form shows why it is unavailable and the server checks eligibility again on save.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

Available while the consent is withdrawn. The original withdrawal, any escalation and the released holds stay in the history. If someone else changed the consent while the form was open, review the current values before trying again. When the form remains available it keeps your entries and refreshes the version for the next submission.
